enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Stretch legs. Sleep. Lie on back. Sleep. Turn to left side. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a quick shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off pajamas. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse off. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, drinking tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out food. Close refrigerator. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Fry eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Toast bread. Spread butter. Make tea. Sit at table. Eat and drink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out clothes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on clothes. Pick up computer. Put in bag. Pick up phone. Put in pocket. Pick up charger. Put in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Sit down. Check emails. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Take elevator. Walk to desk. Put phone in pocket. Open office door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check meetings. Make phone calls. Talk to colleagues. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Write notes. Attend meeting. Discuss programs.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from desk. Walk out of office. Walk to nearby cafe. Enter cafe. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Throw trash. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the office, meeting community partners and planning upcoming events
enriched_activities.desc: Open computer. Open document. Type notes. Attend meeting. Shake hands with partner. Discuss plans. Write on whiteboard. Use projector. Make phone calls. Send emails. Organize files. Create schedule. Talk to team. Review plans. Update calendar.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from work in the heat
enriched_activities.desc: Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Fan self with hand. Board bus. Sit down. Wipe sweat. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Take off shoes. Put down bag. Walk to kitchen. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a light dinner and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out food. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Serve food. Eat.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting quietly with the fan on, avoiding air conditioner use during peak grid hours
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Rest. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Rest. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Rest. Get up. Turn off fan. Walk to living room.
Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channels. Sit on couch. Watch TV. Check phone. Get snack. Return. Sit down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom. Put phone down.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out. Pick up towel.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Read. Put down book. Turn off lamp. Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to other side.
